assessor: RTS governed build assessment — Child C incremental resumable intelligence compiler

assets.notes: Reuse provenance, fail-closed validation, lifecycle non-authority.
Reuse deterministic bounded state, source identity, restart-safe semantics.
Reuse append-only governance, WIP=1, assessment/preflight and verification.

gaps: No repository-local compiler currently guarantees raw-first persistence plus independent chunk checkpoints.
No current learning loop proves successful chunks survive later failure/quarantine.
queries: outcome learning checkpoints resume quarantine idempotency

rationale: Child C is bounded to repository-local raw-first learning compilation. Completed task outcome/evidence is persisted before compilation; observations are chunked deterministically; successful chunks checkpoint independently; failed chunks retry then quarantine without invalidating completed main work; differential reevaluation is explicit and proposal-only.
risks: Learning failure could incorrectly roll back completed task state.
A poison chunk could block the entire queue.
Full-corpus reevaluation could become the accidental default.
Proposal output could be mistaken for applied promotion.
